facts.text: The hotel is on Saadiyat Island in Abu Dhabi, on Saadiyat Beach.
facts.excerpt: Host your next corporate event or social gathering at this luxury hotel nestled on Saadiyat Beach.

facts.text: The resort has five swimming pools, including an adults-only pool, a family pool and a child-friendly pool.
facts.excerpt: Take a serene dip in the exclusive adults-only pool, make cherished memories in the family pool or delight in the charm of our child-friendly pool

facts.text: Camp Hyatt is a facility for younger guests with indoor and outdoor recreational activities.
facts.excerpt: Several fun and interactive indoor and outdoor recreational activities ensure children have an unforgettable stay at the resort.

facts.text: Guests can play the 18-hole championship Saadiyat Beach Golf Course, designed by Gary Player.
facts.excerpt: Elevate your stay with a round of golf on this spectacular 18-hole championship course, designed by the legendary Gary Player.

facts.text: Atarmia Spa offers organic treatments.
facts.excerpt: Immerse yourself in an exquisite selection of organic treatments

facts.text: The fitness facilities include flood-lit tennis and padel courts.
facts.excerpt: enjoy the thrill of a game on our flood-lit tennis and padel courts

facts.text: Mate serves Argentinian cuisine with a contemporary Lebanese twist.
facts.excerpt: Maté is a vibrant and dramatic culinary experience offering Argentinian cuisine with a contemporary Lebanese twist.

facts.text: Mate is listed as a MICHELIN Guide restaurant.
facts.excerpt: A MICHELIN Guide Restaurant

facts.text: Beach House serves Italian cuisine influenced by recipes from the southern Italian coast, with views over Saadiyat Beach.
facts.excerpt: The Beach House restaurant offers an exceptional dining experience featuring authentic Italian cuisine influenced by recipes from the southern Italian coast.

facts.text: The Library is a tea lounge with orange leather panels, black marble accents and an open fire feature.
facts.excerpt: With its orange leather panels, accents of black marble and an open fire feature, The Library is the perfect place for intimate meetings in a residential setting.

facts.text: The Cafe serves Middle Eastern specialties alongside international dishes and has a show kitchen.
facts.excerpt: The Café Restaurant offers a delectable array of Middle Eastern specialties alongside international dishes, all prepared with authenticity and flair.

facts.text: Beach House Shala Lounge is a barefoot beach lounge on the shores of Saadiyat Island.
facts.excerpt: Beach House Shala Lounge is a barefoot haven on the shores of Saadiyat island, inspired by bohemian free spirits that enjoy the good life.

facts.text: The beach view villas are stand-alone villas with a separate bedroom, kitchen, living room and a large terrace with a private plunge pool.
facts.excerpt: It features a separate bedroom, kitchen, a living room and a large terrace with a private plunge pool, rain shower and sun loungers.

facts.text: Rooms have Le Labo Bergamot 22 bath amenities.
facts.excerpt: Artisan-crafted Bergamot 22 amenities by Le Labo

facts.text: Rooms have a private balcony or terrace with views of the Arabian Sea, the gardens or the pool.
facts.excerpt: enjoy stunning views of the Arabian Sea, landscaped gardens, and the pool from your private balcony or terrace.

facts.text: The Park Ocean View Terrace Suite is on the top floor and has an outdoor terrace with a hot tub.
facts.excerpt: Indulge in a unique staying experience with our signature, luxurious top-floor Park Ocean View Terrace Suite. A sprawling outdoor terrace — featuring a hot tub

facts.text: Valet and self parking are free.
facts.excerpt: We offer 24-hour valet service to hotel guests and visitors.

facts.text: The hotel runs a daily shuttle to Yas Island, covering Yas Waterworld, Ferrari World, Warner Bros. World and SeaWorld.
facts.excerpt: We offer daily shuttle service to Yas Island, covering Yas Waterworld, Ferrari World, Warner Bros. World and SeaWorld.

facts.text: Zayed International Airport is about 30 kilometers away.
facts.excerpt:
Zayed International Airport (AUH)

30.4 Kilometers

facts.text: Hawksbill turtles nest on Saadiyat Island, and an in-house marine biologist offers tours at specific times of the year.
facts.excerpt: an in-house marine biologist offers tours at specific times during the year

facts.text: Hawksbill turtles nest on Saadiyat Island.
facts.excerpt: Another big attraction here: the Hawksbill turtles that nest on Saadiyat Island.

facts.text: Camp Hyatt is free for kids ages five and above.
facts.excerpt: Camp Hyatt, where kids ages five and above can play in supervised surrounds for free

facts.text: The hotel has Forbes Travel Guide Responsible Hospitality sustainability verification.
facts.excerpt: Park Hyatt Abu Dhabi achieves Responsible Hospitality Sustainability Verification by Forbes Travel Guide
